baseline.comparison_scope: application execution trust for settlement transitions
baseline.baseline_summary: A smart-contract AMM relies on Ethereum-style consensus and EVM execution for deterministic replay. The target for ZenoDEX is to make every settlement transition independently rejectable by full-node replay or succinct proof verification, with unsupported surfaces failing closed.

host_adversary_model.required_response: Verifiers reject unless a transition is replay-valid or proof-valid under a governed profile.

required_surfaces.trust_effect: Host execution trust is removed for the covered successful spot v1 guest path when the verifier checks the allowed image and journal bindings.
residual_limits: not a complete spot block proof

required_surfaces.trust_effect: Malformed or unsupported proof metadata fails closed before ledger admission.
residual_limits: metadata binding is not proof cryptography

required_surfaces.trust_effect: Structural diagnostics can check caller-authored report shape; replay-bound verification rejects those report inputs.
residual_limits: caller-authored reports carry no cryptographic authority
replay-bound proof authority requires an opaque authenticated verifier capability

required_surfaces.trust_effect: Local checkpoint replay binds a checked segment to signer quorum evidence.

required_surfaces.required_to_close: Move UPBA v2/v3 batch clearing, exact-out, and candidate-grid optimality into a real zkVM guest or require full deterministic replay for every admitting validator.
Proof-bind critical action packets and separate transition validity from oracle truth and governance assumptions.
Cover zUSD mint, liquidation, recovery, and supply-conservation transitions by zkVM proof or mandatory replay.
Cover perps settlement, liquidation, ADL, funding, and insurance transitions by zkVM proof or mandatory replay.
Cover proof-mining manager rewards, claimability, and reward payout bridge execution.
Implement real recursive epoch receipt aggregation with metadata and verifier-profile admission.

promotion_gates: No profile may claim lower-than-Uniswap trust while any required surface is open_gap or replay_supported_with_gap.
Every proof-required profile must name an allowed proof kind, verifier id, guest image id, and toolchain lock hash.
Every proof-required block must carry proof metadata and a verifier-backed report, or be rejected.
Every unsupported operation under a proof-required profile must fail closed before settlement.
Full nodes must retain deterministic replay for audit and fallback until recursive block proofs cover the full admitted surface.
